minors.issue: The ticket says Invoke calls ResolveTarget when Target.Project is not empty, but resolve calls it whenever the target is not empty. A target with only Environment set is resolved as the unknown project "" rather than treated as org-level or rejected, and no test covers this case.
minors.scenario: Invoke with Target{Environment: "prod"} under a "*" row returns registry.ErrNotFound with the message `project "" not found` and audits `not found`. This is harmless, because no row can name an unresolved column, and W2-11f always fills Project.
